title: AutoDOC adoption baseline
description: Machine-generated record of findings observed during adoption, written by `enforce.py --write-baseline`. Entries are keyed by rule, location and a fingerprint of the detail, and carry the date they were recorded; AutoDOC fails only findings that are new, warns about entries that no longer match, and --write-baseline prunes them. Security findings (secrets.inline) are never recorded. Human-edited configuration stays in autodoc.toml; this file is never hand-edited.
